limitations: Successful corridors reserve copper and via extents against subsequent different nets; failed corridors remain unconnected. Full power/AGND return routing remains OPEN.
Pad escape may traverse only endpoint own courtyard; actual other-net pads and substrate remain excluded.
Courtyards block their own face; plated through pads and substrate removals block both faces.
Via drills/annuli are explicit proposals, not fabrication acceptance.
No universal feedback length or stability threshold inferred.
